AUTHOR: Ditria
TITLE: Automating the Analysis of Fish Abundance Using Object Detection: Optimizing Animal Ecology With Deep Learning
REGION: Tweed River Estuary and Tallebudgera Creek, southeast Queensland, Australia
DATA: Own footage: submerged action cameras in seagrass meadows, Feb-Jul 2019; 6,080 annotated fish
V_EV: Discussion: 'different environmental conditions which vary with tides, water clarity, ambient light, and differences in non-target fish species and backgrounds, further work to quantify these differences would be needed'
D2: Train/val: three randomized 80/20 frame splits of 6,080 annotations; test: separate unseen videos (Unseen n=32, Novel n=32; human test 31 videos, 50 images)
D_EV: Model Performance: 'We therefore also tested the model against annotations from two types of new footage not used for the training dataset.'
R_EV: Model Performance: 'as well as from a novel location ("Novel"), being seagrass meadows in a separate estuary system in Tallebudgera Creek'; Fig. 3 reports Unseen vs Novel separately
C_EV: Methods: 'All predictions were made with a confidence threshold of 90%'; 'This threshold was chosen as it typically maximized F1 performance by filtering out false positives.'
E_EV: Human vs. Computer: 'Participants were required to estimate the MaxN of luderick in any single frame per video and per still image'; Table 1 false negatives/positives
ARCH: Mask R-CNN (maskrcnn-benchmark, Massa & Girshick 2018) with ResNet50 backbone
METR: mAP50 (segmentation mask), F1 on MaxN, false negatives, false positives, accuracy (observed/ground truth), analysis speed
NOTE: Train/validation split is a random 80/20 split of frames (5 fps) from the same trimmed videos, i.e., frame-level random; however the reported test performance is on separate unseen videos (same estuary) and novel-estuary videos, so D1 coded at the video level for the test separation. A verifier may prefer D1 = 이미지/프레임 무작위 (then D_ALL = N). Number of training videos is not stated; only test video counts (32/32, 31) are reported. Fixed 0.9 confidence threshold; the paper says it 'typically maximized F1' but no results at several thresholds are shown, so C_ALL = N (a verifier could argue P). FP/FN counts in Table 1 come from comparison with expert ground truth of the same footage, not an independent reference. Cameras are unbaited submerged action cameras deployed 1 h (coded 고정 카메라/관측소). Water clarity only mentioned qualitatively.
